skills.name: Site safety compliance and risk assessment (WSH Act / OSHA 1994)
Subcontractor coordination and daily toolbox briefings
Concrete works inspection (formwork, rebar, slump and cube tests)
Site progress reporting and daily site diary
CIDB Green Card (Site Safety Induction Course)
Method statements and HIRARC / risk assessment preparation
Communication with construction crews in English, Bahasa Malaysia and Mandarin
Setting out and levelling (auto level, total station)
Material requisition and delivery order (DO) inspection on site
Bar bending schedule and rebar inspection

local_notes: Malaysian sites expect a CIDB Green Card and CIDB-registered Site Supervisor, while Singapore employers look for the BCA-recognised BCSS certificate and WSH Act knowledge, and site crews are typically briefed in English, Bahasa Malaysia and Mandarin.
